title: Relative Clauses with Que and Onde
module: Módulo 7 — Pronomes, relações e estruturas complexas

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Describe a person and a place without naming them” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Use que for person/object relative clauses and onde for locations.
student.structure: noun + que + clause; place + onde + clause
student.english_comparison: English who/that/which often map to que; where maps to onde.

model_sentences.pt: A pessoa que trabalha aqui é minha amiga.
model_sentences.en: The person who works here is my friend.

model_sentences.pt: Esta é a cidade onde eu nasci.
model_sentences.en: This is the city where I was born.

model_sentences.pt: O livro que comprei é bom.
model_sentences.en: The book that I bought is good.

model_sentences.en: I know a woman who speaks Portuguese.

model_sentences.pt: Este é o lugar onde moramos.
model_sentences.en: This is the place where we live.
